prompt: Camera at wheel height on wet turf a little way down the hill from the bunker in the first image, looking back up at it. The dented grey six-wheeled robot from the second image rolls towards the lens, close and sharp, taking up the left half of the frame: amber beacon glowing on its stalk, ragged faded bunting flapping from a wheel, mud on her tyres. Behind her, soft and blurred up the slope, the bunker's shut green doors with plain concrete above them, a few fallen bricks at the threshold and a faint haze of dust still settling. Dull grey daylight, the beacon the one warm light. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, no lettering.
